description: Job costing for one job: contract, invoiced, collected and revenue against labor (approved and pending time at each entry's cost rate), materials at cost, expenses and Doing Work fees, with profit and margin. Owner or office; needs seeing costs and prices.
name: costs_job

collected_minor.description: Paid through Doing Work, net of refunds, lost disputes and tips, plus invoices recorded as paid outside.

contract_minor.description: Signed quote totals (tax included) plus approved change orders.

draft_invoices_minor.description: Amount in minor units of the currency (cents).

expenses_minor.description: Expenses on the job in the shop's currency, as entered (receipt totals).

fees_minor.description: Doing Work fees taken from the job's payments.

invoiced_minor.description: Sent and later invoices, tax included; drafts and voided invoices left out.

labor_cost_minor.description: Approved and pending minutes at each entry's copied cost rate, rounded half up.

labor_minutes.description: Approved and pending minutes on the job (running clocks not counted).

labor_pending_cost_minor.description: Amount in minor units of the currency (cents).

margin.description: profit / revenue, 4 decimals; null while revenue is 0.

materials_cost_minor.description: Materials used, quantity x unit cost, rounded half up per line.

materials_price_minor.description: The same materials at their recorded prices (what they would bill at).

refunded_minor.description: Refunds and lost disputes on the job's payments.

revenue_minor.description: invoiced - tax - refunded. What the job earned so far.

tax_minor.description: Sales tax on those invoices; it is not the shop's money, so revenue leaves it out.

unbilled_minor.description: contract - invoiced: signed work not yet invoiced (tax included both sides).

uncosted_materials.description: Material lines with no unit cost; they count as zero cost.

uncosted_minutes.description: Minutes with no labor cost rate set; they count as zero cost. Set rates with timesheets.setRate.
